notes: Correctly produced 駅はどこですか and この電車は速いですか during placement; retrieved both question formation and 駅はどこですか correctly again in Lesson 001.

meaning: polite negative for noun and な-adjective predicates
notes: Pattern remained correct in Lesson 001, but 静か was not retrieved; vocabulary rather than grammar was the problem. In Lesson 002, 静か was retrieved but the learner first used 静かません, then corrected to 静かじゃないです after feedback; review again soon.
Explained in Lesson 001 and used correctly in familiar question patterns. Continue mixed production rather than isolated drills.
Initially confused with で in コンビニを水で買います in Lesson 001, then stabilised. In Lesson 002, 水を was retrieved correctly in both past shopping production and the final に/で contrast.

Used destination に correctly in Lesson 001. In Lesson 002, existence-location に was learned and mostly produced correctly; one guided action sentence incorrectly used コンビニに水を買います before the に/で contrast was corrected and later mastered.

meaning: place of action or means marker
notes: Initially confused with を in Lesson 001, then used correctly. In Lesson 002, one guided action-location item used に instead of で, followed by correct ホテルで食べます and コンビニで水を買います in uncued production.
Understood as present/future depending on context. Retrieved correctly again in Lesson 002 with ホテルで食べます.
Initially used 買います with 昨日 once in Lesson 001, then corrected. Retrieved correctly in Lesson 002 as 昨日、コンビニで水を買いました.
Produced 行きません correctly in Lesson 001 and again in Lesson 002 in 明日、電車で京都に行きません.
Introduced during Lesson 001 after the learner was unfairly prompted for an untaught form. Subsequently produced 買いませんでした, 食べませんでした, and 行きませんでした correctly; not directly retrieved in Lesson 002.

Introduced in Lesson 002. Correctly distinguished from います and produced in 近くにコンビニがあります, 駅の前にホテルがあります, ホテルにレストランがあります, and コンビニに水があります. One early sentence omitted location に / used unnatural order: コンビニがちかくあります.
Introduced in Lesson 002. Correctly selected for people and animals and produced in あそこに猫がいます, ホテルに友達がいます, and 駅の前に友達がいます.
